domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record located. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits were not retrievable: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and Google/Bing queries returned irrelevant results (Bing returned tennis-player pages for the query). note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records, not by website claims: Tuticorin Sea -> Rotterdam (NL) BOL 5762567 dated 2025-09-26, Tuticorin Sea -> Silver Water (AU) BOL 4971562 dated 2025-09-25, Tuticorin Sea -> Jamesburg (US) BOL 2422559 dated 2025-09-24, plus Chennai Air Cargo -> Schiphol (NL) BOL 9917435 dated 2026-02-23. Declared HS 090240 (black tea, >3kg) is broadly consistent with the observed tea/teabag trade, but the actual recorded codes on the export rows are 9021010 / 9023010 / 09021010 / 09024040 (teabags and green tea, i.e. sub-10-digit variants of the 0902 tea heading) — the declared 6-digit 090240 is a heading-level match, not an exact code match; per project rules this is not a rejection ground and the code should be recorded as the factual 0902 tea family. Note the two ImportKey profiles are two distinct addresses (Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu vs Willingdon Island, Cochin, Kerala) under near-identical names; both show export activity, and the Cochin profile's supplier list explicitly links 'SARAF TRADING CORPORATION PVT LTD' with 'SARAF TRADING CORPORATION PRIVATE LIMITED', so they appear to be the same group — but I did not verify a single legal entity/CIN, so entity identity is unconfirmed. Import rows (flavours from Instantina/Frey Lau, acetate PET boxes from Guangzhou Best Pack) show the company also imports inputs, consistent with a tea packing operation. Domestic supply side is a genuine gap: no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence found, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' — absence of evidence here reflects search-tool failure, not proven absence of domestic sales. No revenue or export-volume figure is stated because the free views expose only row counts, not values.
